20: import java.text.BreakIterator;

22: import opennlp.tools.util.Span;

25: /** A {@link BreakIterator} that splits sentences using an OpenNLP sentence chunking model. */
26: public final class OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator extends BreakIterator {
27: 
28:   private CharacterIterator text;
29:   private NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceOp;
30: 
31:   public OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceOp) {
32:     this.sentenceOp = sentenceOp;
33:   }
34: 
35:   @Override
36:   public int current() {
37:     return text.getIndex();
38:   }
39: 
40:   @Override
41:   public int first() {
42:     sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(0);
43:     sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
44:     text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
45:     return current();
46:   }
47: 
48:   @Override
49:   public int last() {
50:     int[] sentenceStarts = sentenceOp.getSentenceStarts();
51:     if (sentenceStarts.length > 0) {
52:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(sentenceStarts.length - 1);
53:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(text.getEndIndex());
54:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
55:     } else { // there are no sentences; both the first and last positions are the begin index
56:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(0);
57:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
58:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
59:     }
60:     return current();
61:   }
62: 
63:   @Override
64:   public int next() {
65:     int[] sentenceStarts = sentenceOp.getSentenceStarts();
66:     if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex() || 0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
67:       return DONE;
68:     } else if (sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence() < sentenceStarts.length - 1) {
69:       int currentSentence = sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence() + 1;
70:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
71:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
72:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
73:       return current();
74:     } else {
75:       return last();
76:     }
77:   }
78: 
79:   @Override
80:   public int following(int pos) {
81:     int[] sentenceStarts = sentenceOp.getSentenceStarts();
82:     if (pos < text.getBeginIndex() || pos > text.getEndIndex()) {
83:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset out of bounds");
84:     } else if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
85:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
86:       return DONE;
87:     } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[sentenceStarts.length - 1]) {
88:       // this conflicts with the javadocs, but matches actual behavior (Oracle has a bug in
89:       // something)
90:       // https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8015110
91:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
92:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(sentenceStarts.length - 1);
93:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(text.getEndIndex());
94:       return DONE;
95:     } else { // there are at least two sentences
96:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence((sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2); // start search from the middle
97:       moveToSentenceAt(pos, 0, sentenceStarts.length - 2);
98:       int currentSentence = sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence() + 1;
99:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
100:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
101:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
102:       return current();
103:     }
104:   }
105: 
106:   /** Binary search over sentences */
107:   private void moveToSentenceAt(int pos, int minSentence, int maxSentence) {
108:     int[] sentenceStarts = sentenceOp.getSentenceStarts();
109:     int currentSentence = sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence();
110:     int beginIndex = sentenceOp.getBeginIndex();
111:     int endIndex = sentenceOp.getEndIndex();
112:     if (text == null || pos < beginIndex) {
113:       return;
114:     }
115:     if (minSentence != maxSentence) {
116:       if (pos < sentenceStarts[currentSentence]) {
117:         int newMaxSentence = currentSentence - 1;
118:         currentSentence = minSentence + (currentSentence - minSentence) / 2;
119:         sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
120:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
121:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, minSentence, newMaxSentence);
122:       } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1]) {
123:         int newMinSentence = currentSentence + 1;
124:         currentSentence = maxSentence - (maxSentence - currentSentence) / 2;
125:         sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
126:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
127:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, newMinSentence, maxSentence);
128:       }
129:     } else {
130:       assert currentSentence == minSentence;
131:       assert pos >= sentenceStarts[currentSentence];
132:       assert (currentSentence == sentenceStarts.length - 1 && pos <= endIndex)
133:           || pos < sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1];
134:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(Math.min(pos, endIndex));
135:     }
136:     // we have arrived - nothing to do
137:   }
138: 
139:   @Override
140:   public int previous() {
141:     int[] sentenceStarts = sentenceOp.getSentenceStarts();
142:     if (text.getIndex() == text.getBeginIndex()) {
143:       return DONE;
144:     } else {
145:       if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
146:         text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
147:         return DONE;
148:       }
149:       if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex()) {
150:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence()]);
151:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence()]);
152:       } else {
153:         int currentSentence = sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence() - 1;
154:         sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
155:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
156:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
157:       }
158:       return current();
159:     }
160:   }
161: 
162:   @Override
163:   public int preceding(int pos) {
164:     int[] sentenceStarts = sentenceOp.getSentenceStarts();
165:     int beginIndex = sentenceOp.getBeginIndex();
166:     int endIndex = sentenceOp.getEndIndex();
167:     if (pos < beginIndex || pos > endIndex) {
168:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset out of bounds");
169:     } else if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
170:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(0);
171:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(beginIndex);
172:       text.setIndex(sentenceOp.getCurrentIndex());
173:       return DONE;
174:     } else if (pos < sentenceStarts[0]) {
175:       // this conflicts with the javadocs, but matches actual behavior (Oracle has a bug in
176:       // something)
177:       // https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8015110
178:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(0);
179:       sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(beginIndex);
180:       text.setIndex(sentenceOp.getCurrentIndex());
181:       return DONE;
182:     } else {
183:       sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(sentenceStarts.length / 2); // start search from the middle
184:       moveToSentenceAt(pos, 0, sentenceStarts.length - 1);
185:       if (0 == sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence()) {
186:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(beginIndex);
187:         text.setIndex(sentenceOp.getCurrentIndex());
188:         return DONE;
189:       } else {
190:         int currentSentence = sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence() - 1;
191:         sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
192:         int start = sentenceStarts[currentSentence];
193:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(start);
194:         text.setIndex(sentenceOp.getCurrentIndex());
195:         return current();
196:       }
197:     }
198:   }
199: 
200:   @Override
201:   public int next(int n) {
202:     int[] sentenceStarts = sentenceOp.getSentenceStarts();
203:     int currentSentence = sentenceOp.getCurrentSentence() + n;
204:     sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
205:     if (n < 0) {
206:       if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex()) {
207:         currentSentence++;
208:         sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
209:       }
210:       if (currentSentence < 0) {
211:         sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(0);
212:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
213:         text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
214:         return DONE;
215:       } else {
216:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
217:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
218:       }
219:     } else if (n > 0) {
220:       if (currentSentence >= sentenceStarts.length) {
221:         currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
222:         sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(currentSentence);
223:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(text.getEndIndex());
224:         text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
225:         return DONE;
226:       } else {
227:         sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
228:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
229:       }
230:     }
231:     return current();
232:   }
233: 
234:   @Override
235:   public CharacterIterator getText() {
236:     return text;
237:   }
238: 
239:   @Override
240:   public void setText(CharacterIterator newText) {
241:     text = newText;
242:     text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
243:     Span[] spans = sentenceOp.splitSentences(sentenceOp.extractText(text));
244:     int beginIndex = text.getBeginIndex();
245:     int[] sentenceStarts = new int[spans.length];
246:     for (int i = 0; i < spans.length; ++i) {
247:       // Adjust start positions to match those of the passed-in CharacterIterator
248:       sentenceStarts[i] = spans[i].getStart() + beginIndex;
249:     }
250:     sentenceOp.setSentenceStarts(sentenceStarts);
251:     sentenceOp.setCurrentSentence(0);
252:     sentenceOp.setBeginIndex(beginIndex);
253:     sentenceOp.setEndIndex(text.getEndIndex());
254:     sentenceOp.setCurrentIndex(text.getIndex());
255:     if (sentenceStarts.length > 1) {
256:       moveToSentenceAt(beginIndex, 0, sentenceStarts.length - 1);
257:     }
258:   }
259: }

18: package org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp;
19: 
20: import java.io.IOException;
21: import java.text.BreakIterator;
22: import java.text.CharacterIterator;
23: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp.tools.NLPSentenceDetectorOp;
24: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp.tools.OpenNLPOpsFactory;
25: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.util.CharArrayIterator;
26: import org.apache.lucene.tests.util.LuceneTestCase;
27: import org.apache.lucene.util.ClasspathResourceLoader;
28: import org.junit.BeforeClass;
29: 
30: public class TestOpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator extends LuceneTestCase {
31: 
32:   private static final String TEXT
33:       //
34:       //         111
35:       //
36:       // 111111111122222222223333333333444444444455555555556666666666777777777788888888889999999999000
37:       // 0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012
38:       =
39:       "Sentence number 1 has 6 words. Sentence number 2, 5 words. And finally, sentence number 3 has 8 words.";
40:   private static final String[] SENTENCES =
41:       new String[] {
42:         "Sentence number 1 has 6 words. ",
43:         "Sentence number 2, 5 words. ",
44:         "And finally, sentence number 3 has 8 words."
45:       };
46:   private static final String PADDING = " Word. Word. ";
47:   private static final String sentenceModelFile = "en-test-sent.bin";
48: 
49:   @BeforeClass
50:   public static void populateCache() throws IOException {
51:     OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceModel(
52:         sentenceModelFile, new ClasspathResourceLoader(TestOpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator.class));
53:   }
54: 
55:   public void testThreeSentences() throws Exception {
56:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
57:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
58:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
59:     bi.setText(TEXT); // String is converted to StringCharacterIterator
60:     do3SentenceTest(bi);
61: 
62:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(TEXT));
63:     do3SentenceTest(bi);
64:   }
65: 
66:   private CharacterIterator getCharArrayIterator(String text) {
67:     return getCharArrayIterator(text, 0, text.length());
68:   }
69: 
70:   private CharacterIterator getCharArrayIterator(String text, int start, int length) {
71:     CharArrayIterator charArrayIterator =
72:         new CharArrayIterator() {
73:           // Lie about all surrogates to the sentence tokenizer,
74:           // instead we treat them all as SContinue so we won't break around them.
75:           @Override
76:           protected char jreBugWorkaround(char ch) {
77:             return ch >= 0xD800 && ch <= 0xDFFF ? 0x002C : ch;
78:           }
79:         };
80:     charArrayIterator.setText(text.toCharArray(), start, length);
81:     return charArrayIterator;
82:   }
83: 
84:   private void do3SentenceTest(BreakIterator bi) {
85:     assertEquals(0, bi.current());
86:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
87:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[0], TEXT.substring(bi.current(), bi.next()));
88:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[1], TEXT.substring(bi.current(), bi.next()));
89:     int current = bi.current();
90:     assertEquals(bi.getText().getEndIndex(), bi.next());
91:     int next = bi.current();
92:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[2], TEXT.substring(current, next));
93:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next());
94: 
95:     assertEquals(TEXT.length(), bi.last());
96:     int end = bi.current();
97:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[2], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
98:     end = bi.current();
99:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[1], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
100:     end = bi.current();
101:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[0], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
102:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.previous());
103:     assertEquals(0, bi.current());
104: 
105:     assertEquals(59, bi.following(39));
106:     assertEquals(59, bi.following(31));
107:     assertEquals(31, bi.following(30));
108: 
109:     assertEquals(0, bi.preceding(57));
110:     assertEquals(0, bi.preceding(58));
111:     assertEquals(31, bi.preceding(59));
112: 
113:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
114:     assertEquals(59, bi.next(2));
115:     assertEquals(0, bi.next(-2));
116:   }
117: 
118:   public void testSingleSentence() throws Exception {
119:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
120:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
121:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
122:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(SENTENCES[0]));
123:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
124:   }
125: 
126:   private void test1Sentence(BreakIterator bi, String text) {
127:     int start = bi.getText().getBeginIndex();
128:     assertEquals(start, bi.first());
129:     int current = bi.current();
130:     assertEquals(bi.getText().getEndIndex(), bi.next());
131:     int end = bi.current() - start;
132:     assertEquals(text, text.substring(current - start, end - start));
133: 
134:     assertEquals(text.length(), bi.last() - start);
135:     end = bi.current();
136:     bi.previous();
137:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.previous());
138:     int previous = bi.current();
139:     assertEquals(text, text.substring(previous - start, end - start));
140:     assertEquals(start, bi.current());
141: 
142:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.following(bi.last() / 2 + start));
143: 
144:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.preceding(bi.last() / 2 + start));
145: 
146:     assertEquals(start, bi.first());
147:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(13));
148:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(-8));
149:   }
150: 
151:   public void testSliceEnd() throws Exception {
152:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
153:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
154:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
155:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(SENTENCES[0] + PADDING, 0, SENTENCES[0].length()));
156: 
157:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
158:   }
159: 
160:   public void testSliceStart() throws Exception {
161:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
162:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
163:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
164:     bi.setText(
165:         getCharArrayIterator(PADDING + SENTENCES[0], PADDING.length(), SENTENCES[0].length()));
166:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
167:   }
168: 
169:   public void testSliceMiddle() throws Exception {
170:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
171:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
172:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
173:     bi.setText(
174:         getCharArrayIterator(
175:             PADDING + SENTENCES[0] + PADDING, PADDING.length(), SENTENCES[0].length()));
176: 
177:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
178:   }
179: 
180:   /** the current position must be ignored, initial position is always first() */
181:   public void testFirstPosition() throws Exception {
182:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
183:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
184:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
185:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(SENTENCES[0]));
186:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[0].length(), bi.last()); // side-effect: set current position to last()
187:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
188:   }
189: 
190:   public void testWhitespaceOnly() throws Exception {
191:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
192:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
193:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
194:     bi.setText("   \n \n\n\r\n\t  \n");
195:     test0Sentences(bi);
196:   }
197: 
198:   public void testEmptyString() throws Exception {
199:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
200:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
201:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
202:     bi.setText("");
203:     test0Sentences(bi);
204:   }
205: 
206:   public void testPrecedingWithTwoSentences() throws IOException {
207:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
208:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
209:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
210:     bi.setText("This is sentence one. This is sentence two.");
211: 
212:     // set pos to somewhere in the second sentence
213:     int precedingSentence = bi.preceding(25);
214:     assertEquals(0, precedingSentence);
215:   }
216: 
217:   private void test0Sentences(BreakIterator bi) {
218:     assertEquals(0, bi.current());
219:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
220:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next());
221:     assertEquals(0, bi.last());
222:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.previous());
223:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.following(0));
224:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.preceding(0));
225:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
226:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(13));
227:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(-8));
228:   }
229: }
